ns2:section.sectionText: This course explores the role of creative thinking in solving problems and seizing opportunities ? in school, life and work (notably the field of advertising). Through class discussion and hands-on exercises, students will learn about theories of creativity, traits of creative people, creative culture and frameworks for sparking creative thinking. Students will develop the ability to ask the right questions, generate ideas of greater quality and quantity, and spot a Big Idea when they see one.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
